basic_details.job_title: YISU Outreach Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Young India Skills University (YISU), Telangana is hiring for 1 Outreach Associate post at YISU, Hyderabad. The job is purely on contract for one year and can be extended based on performance and institutional requirements. Pay will be fixed based on experience and as per university norms. The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in any discipline with excellent communication skills. Indian citizens apply online through the "Apply now" link at yisu.in/careers. The last date is 8 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About YISU
content_sections.text: Young India Skills University (YISU) is in Hyderabad. It was set up under the Young India Skills University, Telangana (Public-Private Partnership) Act 2024 (Act No. 13 of 2024 of the Government of Telangana) to close the gap between what industry needs and what universities teach. YISU runs on a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, in which the Telangana government and industry leaders work together to keep the curriculum in line with real-world demands.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens can apply. The post is unreserved, but the notice encourages candidates from reserved categories to apply. Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Telugu; Hindi is an added advantage. Telephone enquiry handling and student/parent counselling. Knowledge of university programmes and admission procedures. Proficiency in WhatsApp, email, social media and digital communication tools. Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets. Target-oriented approach with initiative in promoting programmes and generating admissions. You must be not more than 30 years old on the last date of submission of applications (8 November 2026). The prescribed qualifications and experience are only the minimum. Meeting them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the selection process. rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with excellent communication skills
rows.preferred_added_advantage: Qualifications in Management, Marketing, Communications or related fields are preferred. Experience in educational counselling, admissions, tele calling or outreach is an added advantage.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay will be fixed based on experience and as per university norms. The notice does not print a pay figure. The job is purely on contract for one year. It can be extended based on requirement and performance. The job does not give any right to a regular appointment, or any claim to regularisation or absorption in the University. The University may offer a position with a lower designation and pay, depending on how suitable the candidate is.

content_sections.heading: YISU Outreach Associate (Contract Basis) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities: Handle incoming and outgoing calls and respond to enquiries about all ongoing and upcoming university programmes. Provide accurate information on programme eligibility, duration, fees and admission procedures. Coordinate outreach activities with schools, colleges, gated communities, corporate organisations and industry partners. Generate prospective student enquiries through telephone calls, digital platforms and outreach activities. Maintain enquiry databases and ensure systematic follow-up with prospective students and parents. Coordinate with academic departments, admissions and administration to address programme-related queries.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for YISU Outreach Associate (Contract Basis)
content_sections.text: Each candidate must check their own eligibility against the prescribed qualifications and experience before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. The University may limit the number of candidates called, based on qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be told by email and/or mobile phone when to appear. The written test and/or interview will be held at YISU, Hyderabad. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in YISU Outreach Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) Outreach Associate (Contract Basis) post. It is unreserved and based at YISU, Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the YISU Outreach Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications is 8 November 2026. Applications received after the deadline, or incomplete in any way, will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the YISU Outreach Associate post?
faq.answer: You need a Bachelor's degree in any discipline with excellent communication skills. Qualifications in Management, Marketing, Communications or related fields are preferred, and experience in educational counselling, admissions, tele calling or outreach is an added advantage.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the YISU Outreach Associate post?
faq.answer: You must be not more than 30 years old on the last date of submission of applications, 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a YISU Outreach Associate?
faq.answer: Pay will be fixed based on experience and as per university norms. The University may also offer a position with a lower designation and pay, depending on the candidate's suitability.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for YISU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the "Apply now" link given with the advertisement at https://yisu.in/careers by 8 November 2026. Print the acknowledgment of your online application and keep it.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the YISU Outreach Associate post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview at YISU, Hyderabad. They will be told by email and/or mobile phone. The University may limit the number of candidates called, based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is the YISU Outreach Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The job is purely on contract for one year and can be extended based on requirement and performance. It gives no right to regularisation or absorption in the University.

faq.question: Q9. Which languages does a YISU Outreach Associate need?
faq.answer: You need excellent verbal and written communication in English and Telugu. Hindi is an added advantage.

faq.question: Q10. Will YISU pay TA/DA for attending the selection process?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
